newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish president sacks agriculture minister.
newsitem.headline: Polish president sacks agriculture minister.

text.p: Poland's president sacked Agriculture Minister and Deputy Premier Roman Jagielinski on Thursday, the presidential press office said in a statement.
President Aleksander Kwasniewski dismissed the minister at the request of Jagielinski's own Peasant Party (PSL), which accused him of incompetence. No replacement was immediately named.
"The president, asked by the prime minister, dismissed on April 10 Mr. Roman Jagielinski from the posts of agriculture minister and deputy prime minister," the statement said.

A motion to dismiss Jagielinski was filed to prime minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz by the PSL, which blamed him for policies resulting in a food trade deficit last year and low grain prices for domestic farmers.

The PSL wants Jagielinski to be replaced by Jaroslaw Kalinowski, a little-known PSL parliamentary deputy, but Cimoszewicz has been delaying his appointment, apparently reluctant to accept his candidacy.
